title: Filters
summary: Photocopy, paper and wear treatments shown on the sample clip: a drained, cracked base grade, copier and newsprint looks, creases, dust and plaster cracks that boil in held steps, and the rip-and-tint cuts. Previews run at full strength; use less in a video.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"footage": {"look": {"name": "grunge_grade", "amount": 0.8}}} and "effects": [{"name": "paper_rip", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 0.3, "amount": 0.9}, {"name": "tint_flash", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 0.25, "amount": 0.8}]. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "xerox", "amount": 0.9, "where": "in"}}. The theme’s own effects are in library/themes/grunge/effects/theme_effects.py; the ones marked Shared come from library/_shared/effects_engine.py.

items.name: grunge grade
items.description: The theme base look: colour drained almost to grey, crushed blacks, a faint warm cast, heavy vignette, grain, and thin white plaster cracks and dust over the picture. Use around 0.8 on footage.

items.name: red wash
items.description: Printed in the one accent colour: shadows soot, midtones hot red-orange, highlights bone, on creased paper. For a beat, not a whole video.

items.name: vignette
items.description: Shared: darkens the corners. Already part of grunge grade; use alone on clean footage.

items.name: grain
items.description: Shared: fine film grain.

items.name: letterbox
items.description: Shared: black bars close in top and bottom.

items.name: photocopy
items.description: A grey office copy: hard contrast, toner banding across the page, burnt dark edges, coarse grain.

items.name: xerox
items.description: A copy of a copy: pure toner on bone paper. Edges break into specks, worn patches drop out, streaks drag down the page.

items.name: halftone news
items.description: Cheap newsprint: one coarse black dot screen at 45 degrees on bone paper.

items.name: paper overlay
items.description: The picture printed on crumpled, folded paper: the crumple shades it and creases wear through to white.

items.name: cracks
items.description: White plaster-crack veins across the picture, as if pasted on an old wall. They boil slightly, eight steps a second.

items.name: dust scratches
items.description: Dirt on the glass: pale specks, hairs and the odd long scratch, plus dark flecks, redrawn eight times a second.

items.name: paper rip
items.description: The signature cut: ragged bands of white torn paper open across the frame (a cross, a diagonal, two slashes), a different rip every third frame, wider with amount.

items.name: tint flash
items.description: The frame turns into a two-colour print on creased paper: teal, then plum, then brick, changing every third frame. Use 0.2 to 0.3 seconds at a cut.

items.name: torn jitter
items.description: Stop-motion handling: the frame becomes a torn print with a ragged white border that jumps and twists every third frame.

items.name: camera shake
items.description: Shared: a short handheld shake, for a stamp or slam landing.

items.name: flash
items.description: Shared: a white flash frame.

items.name: whip
items.description: Shared: sideways motion blur, as if the camera whipped across.

items.name: zoom blur
items.description: Shared: a radial blur punching in.

items.name: shutter
items.description: Shared: black shutter blades close from top and bottom.

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
